t: This is 10 Regents Park Road, a twentieth-century apartment building in Primrose Hill, in the NW1 postcode. It was designed by Ernő Goldfinger, the Hungarian-British architect and furniture designer, who lived from 1902 to 1987. Goldfinger is the reason to stop here. Take a moment to look at the building as the work of an architect who made his name in modernist design, set among the streets of Primrose Hill.
